review.brief: Review the diff 04713db..HEAD for RM44-platform-add-mirror-watermark (tier 4 of roadmap RM44, ticket MAG-48). TWO reviewers, one per module, dispatched in parallel. telemetry-reviewer: internal/telemetry + its migration + sqlc output. charging-reviewer: internal/charging + internal/app + cmd/poller + sqlc.yaml (internal/app consumes charging's new port and implements roadmap D5, charging's own contract). Validate: module-boundary compliance (ai/architecture.md); every doc-pack convention; that the delta specs cover what shipped; test QUALITY by reading the tests (do NOT run them); the read-heavy Performance-Profile; that every DB object matches the user-confirmed design in design.md (a mismatch is a blocker); that the integration tests assert design.md's PRE-AUTHORED expected values (T-tel-1..7, T-cw-1..6, T-app-1..3) rather than whatever the implementation happens to produce; and the anti-gaming checks (no weakened acceptance criteria, no self-approved statuses). HIGHEST-VALUE TARGET: roadmap D5. The watermark must never advance to now(), and must be left completely untouched on a zero-row read. A violation is silent, undetectable data loss. Verify it in internal/app/processor.go AND that the tests actually pin it. Signals: all assistant-run (go build ./..., go vet ./..., gofmt -l, six guards, openspec validate --strict) PASS. The SUITE was run and reported PASSING by the OWNER, not by the assistant.

Confirmed D20 in all four places (query.sql, generated code, interface, reader) plus T-tel-2; D7's named inner field, not embedding; D9's log line prints only account, since, rows. All 7 Test Contract cases reproduce design.md's pre-authored values, not back-fitted from the implementation.

rounds.notes: Read doc pack: CLAUDE.md, ai/architecture.md, ai/go-conventions.md, ai/agentic-workflow.md, internal/charging/AGENTS.md. Read change artifacts: proposal.md, design.md, tasks.md, specs/charging/spec.md, specs/charge-session-log/spec.md. Rebuilt facts independently: re-ran go build ./..., go vet ./..., gofmt -l, make migration-guard, make boundary-guard, openspec validate --strict -- all pass. D5 verified line-by-line in internal/app/processor.go: watermark advances only to the max observed updated_at (never clock.Now()), a zero-row read continues before touching mirrored/maxUpdated/AdvanceMirrorWatermark, and AdvanceMirrorWatermark is called only after a successful MirrorSessions. T-app-1/2/3 in processor_test.go pin exactly these three cases with the design.md pre-authored values (fixed dates, three out-of-order sessions, a failing SessionWriter). T-cw-1..6 in db_mirror_watermark_integration_test.go pin the pre-authored Test Contract values, no pgtype in assertions. mirror_watermarks table matches D21 exactly: id, account_id UNIQUE, source_updated_at, created_at, updated_at -- no tesla_id, no source, no index beyond UNIQUE(account_id). MirrorWatermark translates pgx.ErrNoRows to (time.Time{}, nil) per D3. MirrorSessions signature unchanged (D22). mirrorOverlap is a new local internal/app constant, not imported from analytics. Migration renumbered to ...0002 because telemetry took ...0001 on the same date and both share one goose_db_version table across MIGRATIONS_DIRS -- reasoning is sound, file is otherwise correct. sqlc.yaml addition (charging_mirror_watermark: "MirrorWatermark") sits entirely inside the existing charging sql: block; no other module entry changed. No boundary violations: internal/app imports no pgtype/chargingdb, holds no pool, reaches both modules only through their public ports. Anti-gaming: no task/criterion edited or weakened; progress.json task statuses match the diff; tests are genuinely DB-backed / unit-level, not placeholders.
